sheets.title: A device link on a locked phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The link opens on the front door either way: sign-in and guest first, nothing in front of them.

sheets.title: After Continue as guest — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: No Identity API configured: the route says what it needs, the way every Identity-plane panel does, and puts the keyboard on it.
sheets.before: empty shell, no h1, focus on body, code still in the address
sheets.after: h1 Approve a device, focus on Sign-in service field (332×44, focus-visible)

sheets.title: Signed in — the code to confirm — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The code the link carried sits in the field; the key that approves it holds the focus.
sheets.before: empty shell: no field, no key
sheets.after: User code ABCD-EFGH, focus on Approve device (.go 44×44)

sheets.title: Approved — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The answer is a mark beside the code; a failure's words go to the tray, never a box on the page.
